name: lis-middleware-js
description: On-premises LIMS middleware connecting the hospital HMIS to laboratory analyzers

scripts.build: tsc -b packages/contracts packages/domain packages/protocol-astm packages/protocol-hl7v2 packages/adapter-cobas-e411 packages/adapter-mindray-hl7 packages/adapter-generic packages/transport packages/analyzer-runtime
scripts.clean: tsc -b --clean packages/contracts packages/domain packages/protocol-astm packages/protocol-hl7v2 packages/adapter-cobas-e411 packages/adapter-mindray-hl7 packages/adapter-generic packages/transport packages/analyzer-runtime
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
